title: Multi-account governance: Organizations, Control Tower i root pristup
summary: Dizajn organizacije po AWS SRA, Control Tower landing zone i kontrole, organization policies (SCP, RCP, declarative, AI opt-out, tag i backup), delegated administrator za sigurnosne servise i centralizovano upravljanje root pristupom sa break-glass procedurom.
title_en: Multi-account governance: Organizations, Control Tower, and root access
summary_en: Organization design per the AWS SRA, Control Tower landing zone and controls, organization policies (SCP, RCP, declarative, AI opt-out, tag, and backup), delegated administrator for security services, and centralized root access management with a break-glass procedure.
